name: Masochism/Sadism
body:
School enchantment [pain]; Level adept 3, antipaladin 3, cleric/oracle 3, inquisitor 2, lathspell 3, mesmerist 2, psychic 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a leather strap soaked in blood)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 1 round/level

This spell comes in one of two forms, chosen when cast. If sadism is chosen, you gain the bonus for each 10 points of damage you deal to another. If you instead choose masochism, you gain the bonuses for every 10 points damage you receive.

Regardless of the type chosen, the damage dealt counts only after DR, immunity or resistance is applied. Nonlethal damage counts toward the damage dealt for bonuses.

You gain a +1 luck bonus on attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks for the round to a maximum of +1 per 2 caster levels you possess.
